vot_derivation: Your time is valued at $8.00/h = 50% x $16.00/h your wage (USDOT convention: personal local travel at 50% of hourly income).
Uncertainty range used: $4.00-$16.00/h (0.5x to 2x; you did not declare one).

Walking minutes count 1.75x and waiting minutes 1.75x a riding minute (plausible 1.5-2x; Wardman 2004, Small & Verhoef 2007); each transfer adds 10 min; each minute the timetable forces you to arrive early counts 0.5x (Small 1982 schedule delay).
Weather (Jan): 67% of days have snow cover (NOAA 1991-2020 normals), each counting outdoor minutes at 1.3x, scaled by your winter aversion 1 => outdoor-minute multiplier x1.202.
